# RedRouter: Chat

Requires `RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL` and, when the instance requires one, `RED_ROUTER_API_KEY`. See
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reddb-io/red-router/main/skills/red-router/SKILL.md for setup.

## Endpoints

- `POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/chat/completions`: OpenAI format
- `POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/messages`: Anthropic format
- `POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/responses`: OpenAI Responses format

## Discover

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models | jq '.data[].id'
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" "$RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models/info?id=<model-id>"
```

Model ids are `provider/model`. A combo is addressed by its bare name and falls back through
several providers automatically.

## OpenAI format

```bash
curl -X POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"<model-id>","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}],"stream":false}'
```

JS (OpenAI SDK):

```js
import OpenAI from "openai";
const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: `${process.env.RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL}/v1`,
  apiKey: process.env.RED_ROUTER_API_KEY,
});
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "<model-id>",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hi" }],
  stream: true,
});
for await (const chunk of res) process.stdout.write(chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content || "");
```

## Anthropic format

```bash
curl -X POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"<model-id>","max_tokens":1024,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}'
```

## Response shape

OpenAI (`/v1/chat/completions`) returns `choices[].message.content`, `finish_reason` and
`usage`. With `"stream": true` it emits server-sent events (`data: {...}`) and ends with
`data: [DONE]`.

Anthropic (`/v1/messages`) returns `content[]` blocks, `stop_reason` and `usage`.

Send `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens` with the same body shape to count input tokens without
generating.
